title: Ongoing psionic operation in the Pentagon

tellings.quote: spoken to people who've confirmed that there is still an ongoing psionic operation being run in the Pentagon.

plain: The claim is that the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US military, is still running an operation that uses psionics, meaning mind powers such as sensing or influencing things at a distance. The journalist Ross Coulthart says he has spoken to people who confirmed that this psionic operation is still going on, though he does not name them. If true, it would mean the military still treats mental powers as a working tool.
